name: round-context
title: DOE Round Context
description: Displays the active DOE Round boundary including Round, Lot, Split Version and Wafer Count for current-round analysis surfaces.

files.content:
import { z } from "zod"

export const RoundSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  product: z.string().optional(),
  lot: z.string(),
  splitVersion: z.string().optional(),
  waferCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
})

export type Round = z.infer<typeof RoundSchema>
